top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a single prize part to Holst, Drucker and Mojsov for GLP-1 physiology and its active form. It covers a complete, independently confirmed arc from human incretin physiology and proglucagon biology to identification of the active peptide, with documented clinical effects on glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The citation is worded around physiology and the active form, which avoids ruling on priority and rewards discovery rather than drug engineering. Attribution (Mojsov versus Habener, and leaving out Knudsen) is a real weakness, but it is a reason to word the citation carefully, not to withhold a mature, field-defining achievement, so no award ranks below it.
